subject: Foundry Labs cohort — request to pool founder stipends / promo credit bundling
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@foundrylabs.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Foundry Labs Ops <ops@foundrylabs.io>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founder stipend pooling — question about promo bundling

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the console metrics. Quick ask: we run a 12-company cohort in August and want to standardize the onboarding package for founders. Historically we give each company a small stipend (credits) plus a sandbox allowance. For cost and billing simplicity we'd like to request that Redwood allow us to pool the per-founder stipends into a single cohort credit pool (one invoice / one promo credit bucket) rather than issuing 12 separate small credits.

Specifics:
- Cohort size: 12 companies (estimated 3 devs each)
- Requested pool: 300k tokens worth of credits usable by any cohort participant over 3 months
- Start window: 1 Aug — 31 Oct

We understand this is outside your standard promo provisioning. Can you advise whether this is possible and what approval path is needed? If easier, attached is a short overview of the cohort and a one-pager on how we allocate stipends.

Appreciate your help,
Asha

--
Asha Patel
Programs Director | Foundry Labs
asha@foundrylabs.io | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Foundry_Cohort_OVERVIEW.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha@foundrylabs.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder stipend pooling — question about promo bundling

Hi Asha — great to hear and thanks for the overview. Short answer: we do support pooled promo credit allocations for partner programs, but there are a couple of operational and commercial constraints we need to clear first.

What I'd need to confirm internally:
1) Billing construct — whether Foundry wants a single promo credit line on our hosted model or a reserved cohort bucket tied to a Sponsor account (affects invoicing).
2) Usage guardrails — token caps per company or per dev to prevent a single team from exhausting the pool early.
3) Accounting treatment — whether Foundry wants us to treat the pool as a prepaid promo (no VATable revenue) or a sponsored discount (affects revenue recognition).

I can start the approval flow if you can confirm the preferred billing approach (single invoice to Foundry vs multiple invoices with consolidated reporting). If helpful, I attached a draft mutual action plan we typically use for cohort partners — we can adapt the language for pooling.

If you’re available next week I can loop in Priya (our partnerships lead) for a 30m touchpoint to finalize details.

Best,
Mateo
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123

Attachment: Draft_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (DOCX, 78KB)

From: Asha Patel <asha@foundrylabs.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founder stipend pooling — question about promo bundling

Thanks Mateo — Foundry prefers a single invoice to simplify our accounting (we handle distribution internally). We also want light guardrails: per-company hard cap of 50k tokens and soft daily rate limits so early adopters don't spike usage. Revenue recognition approach is fine to leave to you — we just need the credits to be non-transferable outside this cohort.

The cohort team is available Mon/Tue next week for a 30m call. Can Priya join?

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Foundry cohort — request for pooled stipend promo (approval ask)

Marissa / Ben —

Need a quick decision on this Foundry Labs ask. Summary below:
- Request: consolidate 12 founder stipends into a single 300k-token promo pool billed to Foundry (one invoice).
- Guardrails requested by customer: 50k token hard cap per company, non-transferable, cohort window Aug 1 — Oct 31.
- Rationale: Foundry prefers single invoice and simplified internal distribution; cohort shows strong potential for expansion into Dedicated later this year.
- Impact: If approved as a promo (prepaid credit), cost to Redwood equals forgone revenue only; if we do reserved Sponsor bucket there’s slight ops lift (account setup + consolidated metering).

Recommended path:
1) Approve as a sponsored promo pool (prepaid credit) up to 300k tokens for the cohort window.
2) Legal to sign a short MOU (I’ve attached a draft MAP we can use).
3) Finance to accept single invoice to Foundry and tag revenue as marketing promo.

If you want numbers: assuming list price we forego ~$3,600 of token revenue (effective cost is marginal). Upside: signal to 12 startups and Foundry partner with 12 potential paid conversions.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock the cohort onboarding plan?

Thanks,
Mateo

> Attachment: Draft_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 Jun 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Foundry cohort — request for pooled stipend promo (approval ask)

Mateo — thanks for the clear summary. I discussed quickly with Ben and Finance — we can provisionally approve the 300k-token sponsored promo pool billed to Foundry with the following conditions: 

1) Put a hard per-company cap of 50k tokens in the promo config (ops to enforce).
2) Credits are non-transferable and expire 2028-10-31.
3) Legal to sign the short MOU and include a clause that Redwood can convert the cohort to a paid pilot if usage exceeds 60% of the pool within the first 30 days.

Ben will coordinate with Finance on the single-invoice handling; Priya, work with Ops to ensure the promo is configured correctly and the MAP is updated. Mateo — please confirm you’ll get Foundry to sign the MOU and schedule the kickoff for the week of 7/30.

Marissa
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0140
